title: Managing Tectonic Hazards: The Three Ps

flashcard_questions.q: The three strategies for reducing the impact of tectonic hazards: Prediction (monitoring for warning signs), Protection (building resistant structures) and Planning (preparing emergency responses).
Using scientific equipment and techniques to monitor the Earth and try to forecast when a tectonic hazard will occur.
A scientific instrument that detects and records vibrations in the Earth’s crust, used to monitor earthquake activity.

flashcard_questions.a: A radioactive gas that can escape from the ground before an earthquake due to stress on rock.
Designing and constructing buildings and infrastructure to withstand the shaking of an earthquake.
